summary.text: Henry Stern represents California's 27th Senate District, spanning from Los Angeles to Ventura County, and was first elected in November 2016.

paragraphs.text: From 2018 to 2022 he chaired the Senate Natural Resources and Water Committee.
A former educator and environmental attorney, he received his undergraduate degree from Harvard University and his law degree from UC Berkeley. He was raised in Malibu and lives in Los Angeles.
